channel.description: Recent content in Support on Blacksburg Museum and Cultural Foundation

item.title: Event Rental
item.description: Event rental information covers available spaces, capacity, rental policies, and booking details. Contact the museum to reserve a room for your next event.

item.title: Volunteer
item.description: Volunteers play a key role in museum operations, visitor services, and event support. Learn about opportunities to contribute your time and skills to our exhibitions and programs.

item.title: Bibliography
item.description: The bibliography page lists primary and secondary sources used in our exhibitions and research. It is a resource for students, historians, and anyone interested in local heritage.

item.title: Sponsor
item.description: Sponsorship helps fund exhibits, education programs, and community initiatives. Discover how your organization can support the museum and amplify its impact.

item.title: Donate
item.description: Donations help maintain exhibitions, educational programs, and historic preservation efforts. Learn how your contribution supports the Blacksburg Museum and Cultural Foundation.
